comparison.objective: Insert and rotate a keystone so an arch survives removal of its wooden centering.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient and place a structural wedge, then remove temporary support without collapse.
comparison.success_condition: Keystone correctly installed and arch self-supporting after centering removal; numeric tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: This tests load-path completion and safe support removal, not tool-mediated notch fracture or loose-fragment recovery.
